title: Cosmic Skeleton and Serpent
description: A surreal painting featuring a skeletal figure holding a blue ornate folding fan in the lower half, surrounded by pink flowers and colorful abstract forms. Above, a purple-robed hooded figure with a crown of glowing cosmic orbs rides a large green serpent through a dark, cloudy sky filled with floating starry bubbles.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a white skeleton in the foreground holding a large blue ornate Japanese folding fan, pink flowers growing around its ribcage, set against swirling colorful abstract shapes. In the upper portion, a hooded figure in flowing purple robes with multiple glowing cosmic orbs for a head rides a large emerald green serpent through a dark cloudy sky filled with transparent bubbles containing stars and galaxies.
